g.text: The sky CLI calls the Python SDK; the SDK and the dashboard call one FastAPI server over HTTP, either a local one that the first call starts at 127.0.0.1:46580, or a deployed one behind the operator's auth.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Each call becomes a request in requests.db and waits in the long or the short queue for a worker; a launch runs in a long worker, which provisions on the clouds and records the cluster in the state database.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: A local server keeps its queues in its own process and runs at most four long workers; a deployed one runs a server process per CPU and a queue manager on port 50011.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
